judgement.reason: Snipe-IT is a single Laravel web app on MySQL whose uploads can be moved to S3 with a contained change.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /var/lib/snipeit (Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: The Dockerfile symlinks uploads, private uploads, backups and OAuth keys into /var/lib/snipeit, and no shown setting in the production image config selects S3 for these files (the S3 disk lines in .env.example are commented out and docker/docker.env is not shown), so local durable state is still nee
